items.subject: Standalone core versus ORUDA required preflight
items.resolution: Core profile no longer requires ORUDA and the default engine registers only the Generic adapter.

items.subject: Incompatible state models
items.resolution: Program, validation, improvement, Git and assurance publication machines are separated by an explicit mapping contract; Java model migration remains.

items.subject: Product implementation complete claim versus official status
items.resolution: Completion claim was replaced with validator-slice and product Full-Chain status.

items.subject: Product E2E naming versus executed fixture scope
items.resolution: The runner, receipts and development gate now identify the scope as Validator Fixture E2E and preserve Product Full-Chain as NOT_RUN.

items.subject: AI behavior validation name versus marker scan implementation
items.resolution: Rename the existing stage to policy marker scan or implement actual repeated agent/model/tool execution.

items.subject: RCA completion versus template-only inference
items.resolution: Template output must be RCA_CANDIDATE until reproduction, first-failure and causal evidence are bound.

items.subject: Git SHA and artifact SHA validation
items.resolution: Use 40 or 64 hex for Git object identity and exactly 64 hex for SHA-256 artifact digests.

items.subject: README links versus actual document names
items.resolution: Broken links were replaced with current authoritative files.

items.subject: PR 17 completion claims versus candidate files
items.resolution: The candidate set was integrated through PR 18 with CANDIDATE_ONLY assurance. Blind execution, human outcome, independent receipts and expert promotion remain HOLD.
